t: This is Upper Brook Street, in the City of Westminster. It's a street with a quietly aristocratic past. Sybil Fane, later Countess of Westmorland, a British socialite, was born here in 1871. So was Blanche Shelley, who became a photographer and writer, and so was Sir George Thursby, born in 1869. Lady Geraldine Somerset, who was born in 1832, died here in 1915. The material I have is thin, so I'll say no more than this: it's a street of private lives, and a few of them began or ended behind these doors.
